name: Typefully
description: Typefully lets agents write and edit drafts, manage the posting queue, and schedule posts for the signed-in user's social accounts. Each user signs in to their own Typefully account through the browser.

prompts.text: Draft a thread about what we shipped this week from these release notes.
What posts are in my queue for the next seven days?
Rewrite my latest draft to be shorter and clearer.

apps.name: Typefully
apps.description: Draft writing, queue management, and scheduling, over Typefully's MCP server with browser sign-in.
